alloy: all u: Spec | ((no a: Axiom | cites[u,a]) and (no s: Spec | cites[u,s])) implies u in Freelancing
all u: Exception | (no s: Spec | cites[u,s]) implies u in Freelancing
all u: Exception | (no f: Fact | cites[u,f]) implies u in Freelancing
all t: Term | (some v: Unit | cites[t,v]) implies t in Misnesting
all u: Unit | circular[u] implies u in Cycle
(all b: Bug | hidden[b] implies b in Finding) and (all c: Conflict | hidden[c] implies c in Finding) and (all t: Test | misleading[t] implies t in Finding)
all b: Bug | hidden[b] implies b in Finding
all t: Test | misleading[t] implies t in Finding
all t: ExpectedFailure | ((no b: Bug | checks[t,b]) and (no e: Exception | checks[t,e])) implies t in UnexplainedFailure
all t: PlainTest | (some b: Bug | checks[t,b]) implies t in Unpinning
all u: Unit | (not used[u] and u not in Conflict) implies u in Orphaning
all u: Unit | (some tr: Trailer | tr->u in Follow.rel) implies u in Misanchoring
all d: Document | ((some u: Unit | d->u in Hold.units) and (no i: Index | d->i in Hold.indexes)) implies d in Misindexing
all f: Fence, u: Unit | f->u in Within.rel implies (no u2: Unit | u2->u in Sit.rel and u2->f in Blocks.rel)
all c: Claim | tested[c] implies c not in Untesting
all c: Claim | (some t: Declared | checks[t,c]) implies c not in Untesting
all d: Document | ((some f: Listing | d->f in Head.rel and (no e: Entry | f->e in Item.rel)) and d not in Given) implies (no p: Plugin | p->d in Over.rel)
all r: Run, p: Plugin | calls[r,p] implies (all d: Given | p->d in Over.rel)
all f: Frontmatter | f not in Listing implies (no e: Entry | f->e in Item.rel)
all d: Document | (some f: Refused | d->f in Head.rel) implies (d in Unreadable and (all r: Run | r in Exits2))
all d: Document | (some f: Refused | d->f in Head.rel) implies d in Unreadable
all r: Run | (some d: Document | d in Unreadable) implies r in Exits2
all r: Run | (some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2) implies r in Exits2
all r: Run | ((some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code1) and (no p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2)) implies r in Exits1
all r: Run | (no p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code1 or r->p in Return.code2) implies r in Exits0
all d: Worded, u: Unit | (d->u in Hold.units and u in Logical and u not in Current) implies u in Reported
all d: Document, u: Unit | (d not in Worded and d->u in Hold.units) implies (u not in Rewritten and u not in Reported)
all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u not in Stated and u not in Unsayable) implies u in Unwritten
all u: Unit | u in Stale implies u in Rewritten
all u: Unit | u in Current implies u not in Rewritten
all u: Unit | u in Handwritten implies u not in Rewritten
all w: Word | (some u1: Unit, u2: Unit | u1 != u2 and u1->w in Voice.rel and u2->w in Introduce.rel) implies w in Apart
doubt: 'used' could echo Rely.rel's wording ('a claim, a definition or a fact of {1} uses {2}'), but Apart's own reading ('whose reading is in another unit than its declaration') is defined via Voice.rel, so I took 'used in one unit' to mean 'voiced/read in that unit' and used Voice.rel.

alloy: all w: Word | ((some u: Unit | u->w in Introduce.rel) and (no u: Unit | u->w in Rely.rel)) implies w in Unused

all t: Term, w: Word | (t->w in Introduce.rel and t->w in Voice.rel and (some u: Unit | u->w in Rely.rel)) implies (w not in Flagged and w not in Undeclared and w not in Misplaced and w not in Apart and w not in Unused)

all d: Document, u1: Unit, w1: Word | (d not in Worded and d->u1 in Hold.units and u1->w1 in Introduce.rel) implies (w1 not in Undeclared and w1 not in Misplaced and w1 not in Apart and w1 not in Unused and w1 not in Flagged)
all s: Trial, sc: Scenario, u: Unit | (s->sc in Pose.scenario and s->u in Leave.rel) implies (u in Held and s->u not in Pose.units and (all u2: Held | u2 != u implies s->u2 in Pose.units))
all sc: Impossible | (no u: Unit | sc->u in Probe.rel) implies (all u: Held | some s: Trial | s->u in Leave.rel and s->sc in Pose.scenario)
all s: Search, sc: Scenario, u1: Unit | (s in Trial and s->sc in Pose.scenario and s->u1 in Leave.rel and (some u2: Unit | sc->u2 in Probe.rel)) implies sc->u1 in Probe.rel
all r: Run | (r->LogicCommand in Ask.rel and ((some sc: Scenario | sc in Raised) or (some u: Unit | u in Contradicting))) implies r not in Exits0
all d: Checked, u: Unit | ((some d2: Document | d->d2 in Context.rel and d2->u in Hold.units) and u in BareFormula) implies u in Held
(all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u not in Term and u in Unchallenged) implies (some w: Signature | u->w in Expose.rel)) and (all u: Unit, w: Word | u->w in Expose.rel implies u in Unchallenged)
all d: Document, u: Unit | (d not in Worded and d->u in Hold.units) implies (no w: Word | u->w in Expose.rel)
all r: Run | (r->CheckCommand in Ask.rel and (some u: Unit, w: Word | u->w in Expose.rel)) implies r not in Exits0
some u1: Unit, d1: Document | d1 in Worded and d1->u1 in Hold.units and u1 in Logical and u1 in Current and u1 not in Reported
all d: Definition | d in AmbiguousAnd implies d in AsItStands
all d: Definition | d in NotAboutSubject implies d in AsItStands
all q1: Quantifier | (q1 in VariableOnce and fits[q1]) implies q1 in AsNounPhrase
all l: Series | l in Many implies l in AsBullets
all l: Series | (l in MoreThanTwo and l in CommaItem) implies l in AsBullets
all l: Series | l in TooLong implies l in AsBullets
some q: Quantifier | q in VariableSubject and q in VariableTwice
doubt: Phrased as 'It must be possible for ... while ...' rather than the exact 'It must be possible that:' colon form; treated as the same existential/satisfiability claim.

alloy: some q: Quantifier | q in VariableOnce and q in ConditionAside
doubt: Phrased as 'It must be possible for ... and to ...' rather than the exact 'It must be possible that:' colon form; treated as the same existential/satisfiability claim.

alloy: some q1: Quantifier | q1 in VariableWithCondition and q1 in NothingToAttach
always (all o: Owner, c: Cleanup | (dispose[o] and c in Registered and c not in Ran and c.on = o) implies eventually runNow[c])
doubt: Read 'a cleanup on it that has not run, the cleanup runs now or later' as universally quantifying that cleanup (not just asserting existence), since 'the cleanup' in the consequent refers back to it.

alloy: always (no o: Owner | throwByCall[o] or (some c: Cleanup | runByCall[c,o]))
doubt: Took 'a call in which code disposes an owner after pulse disposed it' to mean exactly the throwByCall/runByCall events (both preconditioned on the owner already being Disposed), so the sentence becomes: these two events never occur.

alloy: (always (all o1: Owner, c1: Cleanup, c2: Cleanup | (dispose[o1] and c1 in Registered and c1 not in Ran and c2 in Registered and c2 not in Ran and c1.on = o1 and c2.on = o1 and c1->c2 in Clock.older) implies ((not runNow[c1]) until runNow[c2]))) and (always (all o2: Owner, c: Failing | (runNow[c] and c.on = o2 and o2 in Disposed) implies always (o2 not in Stopped)))
doubt: The two bullets under the first clause's 'then' ('cleanup_2 runs now or later' / 'cleanup_1 does not run at every moment up to but not including that') are exactly the brief's definition of 'until', so I collapsed them to '(not runNow[c1]) until runNow[c2])'; the second clause's inner 'now and at every later moment' is read as a nested 'always' inside the outer one.
